overall.headline: Global EFB and Flight Planning Selections
observations: Across **519** airlines, **127** record EFB selections led by **AvioBook** (**21** of **127**, **16.5%**), while **68** record flight planning led by **Lido** (**24** of **68**, **35.3%**).
Large Flag Carriers and LCCs show distinct tool distributions, though small-sample constraints mean missing fields remain unrecorded rather than indicating non-adoption.
overall.caveat: Counts reflect recorded selections rather than absolute market share, and missing data points represent unknown statuses.

regions.name: Europe & Central Asia
regions.headline: European Region EFB and Planning Patterns
observations: In **151** airlines, **35** record EFB selections led by **In-house built** (**7** of **35**, **20.0%**) and **AvioBook** (**6** of **35**, **17.1%**).
Planning-recorded stands at **14**, led by **Lido** (**5** of **14**, **35.7%**), aligning closely with the overall **35.3%** Lido rate.
regions.caveat: Unrecorded fields are strictly unknown, and multi-select entries may count individual airlines multiple times.

regions.name: East Asia & Pacific
regions.headline: East Asia and Pacific Technology Choices
observations: With **130** airlines, **39** record EFB selections featuring **In-house built** (**9** of **39**, **23.1%**) and **Paper** (**6** of **39**, **15.4%**).
Planning selections total **18**, where **NavBlue** records **9** of **18** (**50.0%**), exceeding the overall **23.5%** NavBlue rate.
regions.caveat: Data represents recorded selections only, and missing fields should not be interpreted as system absence or rejection.

regions.name: North America
regions.headline: North American Carrier Selections
observations: Among **59** airlines, **14** record EFB selections led by **AvioBook** (**5** of **14**, **35.7%**), significantly above the overall **16.5%** AvioBook rate.
Planning-recorded totals **9**, dominated by **FlightKeys** (**5** of **9**, **55.6%**), contrasting with the overall **17.6%** FlightKeys rate.
regions.caveat: Figures are aggregate selections, and uncaptured carrier segments reflect missing data rather than deliberate non-adoption.

regions.name: Latin America & Caribbean
regions.headline: Latin American Market Adoption Insights
observations: Out of **56** airlines, **12** record EFB selections with **AvioBook**, **Flightman**, and **Paper** each at **2** of **12** (**16.7%**).
Planning-recorded reaches **9**, led by **Lido** (**4** of **9**, **44.4%**), outperforming the overall **35.3%** Lido rate.
regions.caveat: Counts are recorded inputs and multi-select entries may duplicate counts; unrecorded records imply unknown adoption status.

regions.name: Middle East & North Africa
regions.headline: MENA Region EFB and Planning Overview
observations: For **51** airlines, **15** record EFB selections led evenly by **Bytron Skybook**, **Jeppesen Aviator**, and **Paper** (**3** of **15**, **20.0%** each).
Planning-recorded stands at **10**, where **Lido** and **NavBlue** tie at **3** of **10** (**30.0%**).
regions.caveat: Missing data points are unrecorded and do not imply non-adoption by unlisted carriers.

regions.name: Sub-Saharan Africa
regions.headline: Sub-Saharan African Technology Landscape
observations: Across **47** airlines, **8** record EFB selections led by **IFS EFBOne** (**2** of **8**, **25.0%**), exceeding the overall **6.3%** rate.
Planning-recorded is limited to **4** airlines, with **Lido** capturing **2** of **4** (**50.0%**).
regions.caveat: Low recording volumes restrict broad market conclusions, and unrecorded fields represent unknown information.

regions.name: South Asia
regions.headline: South Asian Regional Adoption Metrics
observations: Among **13** airlines, **4** record EFB selections across **AvioBook**, **In-house built**, **Navblue Mission+**, and **Paper** (**1** of **4**, **25.0%** each).
regions.caveat: Small sample sizes mean absence of records denotes unknown data rather than intentional non-adoption.
